launches.title: Warmly - Always-On AI Sales Agent for Your Website
launches.tagline: AI that gives demos, qualifies leads, and books meetings on your website 24/7
launches.body:
Hey YC 👋 We're Max, Carina and Alan, founders of Warmly.ai.

**TL;DR**: We just launched **AI Autopilot**: an always-on agent that lives on every page of your website, identifies visitors at the person level before any form fill, gives demos, qualifies prospects, books meetings, and retargets the rest. Customers running it are converting 30% more inbound traffic. Setup is a script tag and 30 minutes.

Launch announcement [here](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/) (would greatly appreciate a comment!).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EHybZmEzyTs>

**The Problem**

Most B2B SaaS companies are bleeding pipeline through their front door.

Your website is your highest-leverage asset. Every visitor you've paid for lands there. They often have the problem you solve but you just might not be fast enough to get to them in time before they leave or go to a competitor.

Buyers now expect to talk to someone immediately. They don’t want to wait a day to schedule a call with an SDR to get a basic question answered.

But every "AI chatbot" we've seen since 2023 has the same architecture under the hood: a stateless GPT wrapper that rebuilds context from scratch on every message, hallucinates, and hands off "qualified" leads with no traceability.

AEs aren’t fans and buyers see through them in two messages.

**What we built**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkvDdJCsqd8>

AI Autopilot is one agent on every page of your site. It pulls from your website, help center, internal docs, sales calls, sales methodologies, and CRM.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/3ec0d6d3-bdec-4a67-9c20-5937dd63216d)

It picks its own qualification path. It generates slide decks on the fly mid-conversation, triggers the right videos by intent, and offers an optional video avatar so visitors talk to a person instead of a widget.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/368692f0-3842-48b8-8297-2cdd41ab78d7)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/e3d90e0a-3c84-418b-b28e-445d7ee67dd4)

When the visitor doesn't book? AI Autopilot doesn't give up. It Slacks your team, sends a personalized follow-up email, and triggers LinkedIn retargeting for your top prospects.

It self-improves.

It analyzes every conversation against the goals you set, tunes itself, and is version controlled. You can watch it get better over time.

In our beta accounts, automated inbound meetings increased 30%.

**Why now**

We started out compiling signals for B2B sales/marketing teams, like person-level website visitor data.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/49b7ce12-478d-4b6f-a812-7a0810f6272a)

In the past year we took a different bet: build a context graph for B2B GTM first, then put agents on top of it.

The context graph is a unified, real-time data layer that connects every signal, action, note, and outcome for every account. When AI Autopilot engages a visitor, it knows they saw your LinkedIn ad last week, your SDR sent a follow-up email yesterday, and they downloaded a case study an hour ago. It doesn't have to "look this up.” The context is already pre-computed in primitive stores it can query in milliseconds.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=100530&key=user_uploads/409563/784e00dd-623d-42b2-94e4-fc67416b54a0)

A blog post we wrote that covers how we think about the GTM space: [GTM Brain: Next Platform Owns Decisions, Not Data](https://www.warmly.ai/blog/gtm-brain).

**Asks for the YC community**

1\. **Drop us a comment on our [launch post](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7455240801065885696/)**. We’d love for more of our community to know us for building GTM agents and not just supply GTM data :).

2\. **Try us out.** Book a demo with us if this is something you’re interested in! <https://www.warmly.ai/p/book-a-demo>

Warmly,

Max, Carina & Alan

launches.body:
Hey YC Community, Carlo here. Today we’re making FirstQuadrant available for the public! This one’s been a long time in the making.

Anand and I started working on this over 2.5 years ago (before ChatGPT was even released). And to be honest, it took a lot of fucking around and finding out. We spoke to over 300+ founders and heads of sales, rebuilt the product from scratch multiple times, and only after countless conversations did it finally click.

So today, we’re excited (and a bit nervous) to finally release FirstQuadrant to the public: An AI sales execution platform that helps founders and revenue teams move faster, stay organized, and close more deals, by streamlining the behind-the-scenes sales-work so nothing ever slips through the cracks.

https://youtu.be/UG5RfdbKPfI

**The Problem:** 

If you’ve ever looked inside a CRM, you know how chaotic things can get. Deals are scattered, updates are missed, and there’s always this underlying anxiety: “Did I forget to follow up?” “Am I waiting on someone to respond?” “Did I send the right documents?”

Most sales reps are great at conversations and closing — but not at the repetitive, behind-the-scenes tasks before and after meetings. That’s where deals fall through the cracks.

**The Solution:**

FirstQuadrant solves these exact problems. Our platform analyzes all your sales conversations and uses advanced AI reasoning to understand where each deal stands and what should happen next.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90182&key=user_uploads/569815/03bcb01a-7e6c-4c01-bb08-0a37d57a6a3f)

It automatically manages tasks like:

\- Following up with leads

\- Rescheduling missed meetings

\- Qualifying new inbound leads

\- Staying in touch with old or inactive contacts

\- Sending resources or summaries post-call

All of this is handled in the background, giving your sales team the mental space to focus on what really matters: selling, meeting with customers, and building relationships.

As a result, your deals move faster, your pipeline gets cleaner, and your reps aren’t constantly playing catch-up.

They don’t have to keep everything in their heads anymore. FirstQuadrant tracks it all and nudges them at just the right moments.

And beyond just managing active deals, it also helps uncover hidden revenue by reactivating older, inactive business relationships (the ones reps never quite get around to following up with). And on the top-of-funnel side, it qualifies new leads that come in, lets you build custom-qualified audiences, and even runs AI-personalized outbound email campaigns at scale. So you’re filling your pipeline with high-quality leads and keeping everything organized and moving forward — all in one place.

**About us**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90182&key=user_uploads/569815/59265b17-f07b-4a4f-ad44-1fa30b6f6091)

Anand (CTO/CPO) is a technology entrepreneur, engineer, and designer. Previously, he founded the accessibility tech startup Oswald Labs and the fashion e-commerce company Melangebox at the age of 18. Before founding FirstQuadrant, he established a Swiss design agency at the age of 20 and bootstrapped it to over 40 employees and multiple millions in revenue. He has been recognized by the EY Entrepreneur of the Year award and listed in Forbes' 30 Under 30.

**Ask & Give**

**What we’re asking:**

If you’ve felt the pain of busy-work in sales, we’d love for you to check out our launch. [Head over to Product Hunt and tell us what you think. ](https://www.producthunt.com/posts/firstquadrant)

2. Additionally the first 10 supporters get $250 worth of AI credits and a free 1h sales consultation where I help you with your entire sales setup (deliverability, channels, website conversion, tool stack... whatever you need help with)

We’re super excited to share what we’ve built — and even more excited to learn from you all. Thanks for checking out FirstQuadrant.

launches.title: Wizwand - Discover SOTA research papers on AI and Machine Learning
launches.tagline: Leaderboards for AI and Machine Learning methods based tasks and datasets
launches.body:
Introducing [Wziwand](https://www.wizwand.com): we help improve reproducibility and transparency in AI/ML research, by allowing research engineers to easily find, implement, and compare the performance of SOTA papers and methods.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98124&key=user_uploads/5992/f8f3f02d-30fd-4116-aa6b-a706323c241f)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98124&key=user_uploads/5992/f7859d08-2837-4aba-858b-dada5295ffa6)

**Why it matters:**

The AI/ML boom hasn’t just increased the number of papers — it has fragmented the landscape. With thousands of preprints hitting arXiv each month, the “state of the art” (SOTA) in a specific niche can change over a weekend. For researchers and research engineers, the cognitive overhead of filtering through incremental gains to find true architectural breakthroughs has become unsustainable. Wizwand is built to help people track AI/ML research progress across a wide range of domains.

**The challenge:**

Over the past many years, several products have tried to solve this problem, but we’ve seen a few common issues:

\- **Table understanding is hard at scale**: Research papers tend to use non-standard tables, which makes extracting the right data points and their correct attributes challenging. A small mistake can produce a wildly incorrect result.

\- **Apples-to-apples comparison is difficult**: Should general image classification methods be compared with medical image classification methods? Should methods tested on the “same” dataset but different versions or splits be compared? When building benchmarks, there hasn’t been a good way to ensure truly apples-to-apples comparisons.

**Wizwand solution:**

\- Table understanding at the paper level is made possible through a combination of LLMs, OCR, and rule-based pipelines. We can extract data points with complex attributes from tables with high accuracy, including non-standard tables.

\- We determine whether two methods are comparable using full-paper understanding — not just dataset and metric. This enables fairer, more meaningful benchmarks.

**Team:**

We’re a team of CS/ML engineers from UC Berkeley, Google, Airbnb, and Microsoft.

**Asks:**

\- We’re looking for feedback from research engineers and researchers to share your feedback and thoughts on how we can improve Wizwand to work better for you.

\- You can reach out to the founders directly at [allan@wizwand.com](mailto:allan@wizwand.com) or follow us on X ([@wizwand_team](https://x.com/wizwand_team)).

launches.tagline: Each web visitor is different. Let your site speak uniquely to each one.
launches.body:
Hi all, we are [Chris](https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrismjelde/) and [Rory](https://www.linkedin.com/in/rorz/), founders of [Kenobi](https://kenobi.ai).

**TL;DR:** _Kenobi is a small widget that asks your website visitors what company they’re from. For those that opt in, the whole page changes in about 3 seconds, making the page hyper-relevant to them._

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/12072fa5-f903-4e42-88b2-5505250f9c5b)

### Problem

98% of web traffic does _not_ convert.

That’s because your website looks the same to everyone: a startup founder and the CFO of a Fortune 500 company get the exact same experience when they land on your site. When you have to speak to everyone, you end up speaking to no-one.

### Solution: Kenobi

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/a085a931-7365-4611-ac7e-e9f801324423)

Kenobi appears on your website as a small widget (we call it a ‘cue card’), prompting site visitors to share what company they’re from.

When a cue card is submitted, our agent collects context on the visitor, marries it up against the deep research its done on the host domain, and swaps the content on the page to make it hyper-personalized and unique, all in 2-3 seconds.

### The value

The value of Kenobi is two-fold:

1. Web visitors that opt-in for a personalized experience engage **3x longer** and convert **2x better** than the average visitor
2. All cue card submissions are sent to you in Slack (much like a deanonymization tool like RB2B, or Vector), so that you can enrich the leads and outbound them

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96117&key=user_uploads/410689/3e972baa-67ec-40bb-9dbd-51044fa7a551)

### Demo video

https://www.loom.com/share/d3145c167cb84172a6dc242ef8e93109

### How we got here

We were building Verdn, a donation software, for 4+ years. We pivoted into building Kenobi in May, and for the last few months we’ve been working with sales teams to generate customized landing pages for outbound campaigns.

During all that time, our #1 feature request has been to cater for inbound web traffic. After tens of thousands of web page variations, we feel like our model is finally good and fast enough to tackle _inbound_ personalization.

### Try it

Go to [kenobi.ai/start](http://kenobi.ai/start) and see in 30 seconds how YOUR page can be personalized to any visitor. If you like how it looks, sign up for our free plan, no CC required.

launches.title: 🚀 Openpod - Incentivize developer contributions and fundraise quickly for OSS projects
launches.tagline: We're helping open source projects launch better with DAO infrastructure and tokens
launches.body:
**TL;DR**

Imagine if you had been able to buy Ubuntu tokens when it first launched…

**Openpod is a DAO-as-a-service platform for open-source projects to incentivize developer contribution and make fundraising easy**. Projects can use these governance/utility tokens to compensate developers for their work, let early investors/speculators purchase these tokens, and reward their community. 

**Check us out here:** \
[openpod.io](http://openpod.io)\
[app.openpod.io](http://app.openpod.io)

### **Problem:**

Launch ramps for open source projects are broken.

* It’s hard to get funding as a new or up-and-coming open source project, even if you have believers. Most of the available funds and donations are often taken by the top open source projects. 
* Maintaining consistent contributions from developers is tough since they are volunteering their time. They are also not compensated for work they did in the early phases of a project - even if it's a successful one.
* It’s tough to get people to use your product early on.

 

### **Our Solution:**

DAOs have long been a solution in search of a problem. **Open source projects are inherently decentralized and function as communities, which are hallmarks of DAOs.**

Openpod is a **DAO-as-a-service platform** for open source projects to establish their own DAO and mint utility tokens. Developers, users, and believers can purchase these tokens on our platform, and **get in early on potential growth** of the project and the token value. They’ll also be able to vote on new features and how the raised funding has been used. Meanwhile, the project can use this immediate funding for development. 

We’re adding Github integration with DAOs so that **when developers commit or push to a project’s repos, they’ll get automatically compensated** based on the bounties associated with their tasks. 

### **Backstory:**

As developers who have worked on open source projects previously, we’ve seen some of the best and brightest people get burnt out while doing work for little to no compensation - especially when these projects are new. So we feel it's only fair to **let developers have a way to earn returns on their hard effort** in the project.

### **Our Ask:**

We’d love to pilot the DAO creation platform with fellow YC companies! If you have a Github repository, and **a few cents to spare**, create your very own tokens for your project. 

**You could use these tokens to incentivize your early users, contributors, and have more people support you as a project.** 

We’re working on integrations to let token holders **redeem the tokens for Open Core/SaaS credits or other perks** **to ensure your tokens will have value**. Users could also sell their tokens to make returns. \
[openpod.io](http://openpod.io) \
[app.openpod.io](http://app.openpod.io)

Deals are more competitive than ever, and sales teams don’t feel prepared to win. Product marketing teams constantly get hit with questions like:

* “How do we beat \[competitor\]?”
* “Do we have a battlecard for this?”
* “What’s our answer to \[new competitor launch\]?”

To find answers, teams have to dig through call recordings, piece together competitor research, and hope they’re making the right call.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88481&key=user_uploads/1213493/b87ca67c-de33-4a14-9dfa-28abc23ce023)

### **The Problem**

Competitive intelligence today is **broken**:

* **Prioritizing junk data** – Teams spend tons of money on web monitoring tools that flood them with alerts that don't actually matter.
* **Ignoring the best source of intelligence—actual buyers** – Most marketing teams review **<5%** of calls and talk to **<1%** of lost prospects. That’s not enough to know why deals are really won or lost.
* **Outdated content** – PMMs spend weeks building battlecards that go stale before they’re used. Sales stops trusting them, and adoption plummets.

### **How Hindsight Fixes This**

<https://youtu.be/vqNqL9ZylVU>

Unlike other CI tools, Hindsight prioritizes competitive insights directly from your buyers AND helps you collect it.

* **Win-Loss at Scale** – AI analyzes 100% of your CRM deals, calls, and emails to uncover decision drivers, identify competitors, and clip key quotes from deals.

* **Real-Time Competitive Intelligence** – Hindsight monitors the web and your other sales tools daily to build and maintain battlecards automatically.
* **Just-in-Time Sales Enablement** – Insights and battlecards are delivered directly in Slack or email so reps always have the right info before their calls. Automatically updated as new insights roll in.
* And a lot more!

### **Why We’re Building Hindsight**

Hey, I’m Ani 👋. I co-founded Hindsight with one of my best friends, Andrew Luo. When I was a PM, I spent too much time **guessing** why we won or lost deals. Our roadmap was shaped by opinions instead of facts, and I struggled to get sales teams aligned with the right messaging.

We built Hindsight to turn every deal into a learning opportunity and make sure sales, product, and marketing are always aligned on the truth.

**tl;dr:** [Speck](https://tryspeck.com) is a browser extension that makes automating repetitive web tasks easy. Our customers use Speck to extract data, perform LinkedIn outreach, collect the newest research papers, gather data about social media groups, and more!

Hey everyone! We’re Lucas and Raghav, the founding team behind Speck.

## 🤔 The Problem

People spend precious time doing menial and repetitive browser-based tasks, such as entering data into CRMs, posting multiple job listings for recruiting, reaching out to contacts on LinkedIn, extracting data from websites, and other similar chores.

These tasks are irritating for most knowledge workers, yet they do not have any way to simplify their workflow. Low-code solutions like UiPath cost tens of thousands of dollars and require a dedicated automations team. On the other hand, executing web-based workflows is outside of the scope of workflow tools like Zapier. 

## 💡 The Solution

With Speck, you can automate any workflow easily **without having any coding knowledge**. Our browser extension allows you to **record workflows just by doing them**. Speck automatically translates your workflows into repeatable steps, making it simple for anyone to create web-based automations and data extraction processes

By keeping track of intent, the **browser automations will repair themselves automatically** when something goes wrong! These workflows can be executed live or scheduled asynchronously on a remote browser. Now, our users can spend less time doing menial chores and more time focusing on higher-impact tasks. 

Since pivoting 2 weeks ago and launching our beta, we’ve gotten our extension published on the Chrome Web Store and onboarded our first paying customers.

Making an automation takes less than 60 seconds.

Hey everyone, we are Theo, Eden, and Victoria — the founders of [FINNY](https://www.finnyai.com/). We help independent financial advisors find and convert new clients, using AI.\
\
If you’re confused as to why the three of us are so excited about building for financial advisors, keep reading.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/89898/9cd181f2-59e6-4458-b5c9-250b9399ee43)

# 🧑‍🔬 **The Team**

**🏦The Sales Whisperer**  

[Eden](https://www.linkedin.com/in/edenovadia/) was most recently at BCG NYC, where she primarily worked in the Tech, Financial Institutions & Private Equity practices. She holds a BEng in Software Engineering from McGill (ML focus). 

**👾The Model Man** 

[Theo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/theodore-janson/) worked as a ML engineer at an early Fintech startup and AI researcher in Explainable ML. He holds a BEng in EE and Math from McGill and MS in AI from Ecole Polytechnique, Paris.

**👩🏼‍🎨The Visionary** 

[Victoria](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-toli/) came from Uber, where she led membership growth for Uber One as a Product Manager. She holds a BS from Stanford in Symbolic Systems (AI focus). 

# **🫶🏻 Why are we obsessed with Financial Advisors?**

* **The Great Wealth Transfer** - $80T of wealth will be transferred from the Boomer/Silent Gen to the next generation over the next 20 years. 
* **Retiring advisors** - 45,000 financial advisors are over the age of 65 in the US, managing $3T in wealth that will change management when they retire.
* **Wealth creation** - Wealth is being created in unprecedented ways (E.g., Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Social media, Racial wealth gain), but the institution serving the wealth has not changed
* **Consolidation** - Private equity driving consolidation of a historically long tail of independent advisors
* **Price Inertia:** Financial Advisors are used to paying 25 bps annually IN PERPETUITY for referrals. That’s $200B annually from the wealth transfer alone.

 

# 💀 **The Problem FINNY is Solving**

Financial advisors manage >$100T in assets globally. Yet, bringing on new clients is highly inefficient. Their best bet is to repurpose horizontal solutions - like Linkedin, ZoomInfo, and Pitchbook - to create long and noisy prospect lists. However, without a proper way to qualify these leads or even reach their particular niche at scale, advisors end up spending an average of **58 hours** going after the wrong, often unqualified prospects before converting one new client.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/1755270/ea1b3592-dc3a-4581-86ad-447709eec5bf)

# 💡 **The Solution**

FINNY is reimagining organic growth for financial advisors with AI. Our first product, a multi-channel Sales agent, allows users to sit back and relax while it goes “out in the wild” (aka our massive database of high-net-worth individuals) and prospects for them. It’s like your intern, except it’s always on, running in the background.

FINNY’s goal is for advisors to wake up in the morning to meetings with prospects on their calendars, entirely booked by FINNY. Our value proposition is three-fold: 

1. **_Prospect identification:_**
   * _We identify prospects within their target niche, aggregating thousands of data points per lead and constantly monitoring for life triggers_

    
2. **_Prospect prioritization_:**
   * We prioritize prospects based on their predicted likelihood of converting, a score unique to each advisor and prospect pair
3. **_Prospect outreach & engagement:_**
   * _We automate the outreach and meeting scheduling with the high-priority prospects, intelligently selecting the optimal channel for the specific prospect_

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=82467&key=user_uploads/1755270/2df42888-af79-4d31-a06f-a153ff0487e7)

# ✅ **Progress so far**

In just 3 months, we have:

* Released the **1st** and **2nd iteration** of the product to 15 advisory firms.
* Grown revenue by >**11x** MoM.
* Got **70** firms to join our waitlist, without any acquisition efforts or outbound.
* **Won** Morningstar’s Fintech Showcase last month.

Hey everyone! We're Kashyab and Rishi, co-founders of Verbiflow 😁

# tl;dr

Verbiflow is the all-in-one platform for sales teams to capture, manage, and automate their entire process. Capture leads with intelligent prospecting that identifies high-potential prospects based on real-time events and smart scheduling & routing that instantly assigns those leads to the best-suited sales rep. Manage your pipeline with complete flexibility, defining and tracking custom KPIs across all your sales interactions. Automate reminders and workflows to keep deals moving forward, all within a single, unified platform.

**Ask:** warm intros to sales leaders 😇 (CRO, VP of Sales, & Director of Sales)

<https://youtu.be/0jZayvEkiI4>

# The Problem 👎

Sales teams are grappling with inefficiencies that plague every step of the sales process, from chasing down leads to sealing the deal. For sales reps, the clock is their enemy: they spend just 35% of their time actually selling, leaving about 6.5 hours a day tangled up in manual chores like data entry, prospect hunting, call logging, and scheduling follow-ups. This time sink costs companies roughly $68,000 per rep each year in lost productivity—like paying for a chef who spends most of their shift washing dishes instead of cooking. It’s not just money down the drain; it’s missed chances, too. Leads are 9x more likely to turn into customers if contacted within 5 minutes, but reps buried under admin work can’t keep up, letting golden opportunities slip away.

Account Executives (AEs) are under pressure to close complex deals, but they’re stuck piecing together past interactions from scattered emails, linkedin messages, notes, and tools to get full context on a deal. This chaos makes it nearly impossible to remember key discussions or spot issues threatening the deal like price objections or competitor mentions early enough to act. AEs lack the real-time insights to tackle blockers as such head-on. Meanwhile, they’re bogged down tracking multiple deals across clunky, disconnected systems, while needing to manually update them too. To top it off, deals often land with the wrong AE—like asking a barber to fix your car; they’re skilled with scissors, not engines, and your car’s not going anywhere fast. Win rates tank, and growth goals slip out of reach.

**The outcome?** A frustrated sales team that’s overworked, stretched thin, and underdelivering on the company’s revenue goals.

Lost knowledge is lost productivity.

Peppr AI turns scattered company data into a living, self-improving knowledge hub to fuel faster decisions across your organization. Through this, Peppr ensures that **no matter** **how much your team scales in size, it can still operate with the same speed as the leanest startups.**

In the perfect information system, no one wastes time hunting for answers, waiting for replies, or sitting through redundant meetings. **Unfortunately, for most organizations today, it's the opposite.**

### **Introducing Paratus – AI-Powered Patient Intake**

**TL;DR**

Patients wait months for an appointment, often with no guidance or symptom tracking in the meantime. When they finally see a doctor, the first 5-10 minutes of the visit are wasted gathering history instead of diagnosing and treating.

**Right now, there are only two ways to handle patient intake:**

* **Static intake forms** – Miss key details, forcing doctors to play catch-up.
* **Triage nurses** – Costly, difficult to scale, and still prone to oversight.

Paratus changes this. Our AI-powered intake assistant gathers symptoms, flags concerns, and delivers a structured clinical summary before the visit even starts—so doctors walk in fully informed.

Watch our demo [here](https://youtu.be/KHh7fp5svY8).

### **It’s Time for a New Wave of AI-Powered Intake**

✅ **Conversational AI engages patients before their visit,** collecting deeper insights than any form ever could.\
✅ **Doctor-approved triage** – Uses **500+ Schmitt-Thompson protocols** and cross-checks medical literature.\
✅ **Instant structured reports** – Doctors walk in fully prepared with:

* Symptom history & differential considerations
* Next steps & testing recommendations
* A pre-visit SOAP note for the EHR
* A full conversation transcript for review

**Think of it as a triage nurse who never misses a detail—at a fraction of the cost.**

### **How It Works**

1. **Instant Patient Connection** – The patient clicks an SMS link and connects with our AI assistant.
2. **Conversational AI Consultation** – Our AI dynamically adapts to responses, uncovering key details just like a triage nurse.
3. **Automated Pre-Visit Reports** – We run the full transcript through our fine-tuned LLM, extracting structured insights for the doctor.

### **The Problem: Long Waits & Inefficient Intake**

* **Months-long wait times** leave patients in limbo with no support.
* **Doctors start visits blind**, leading to rushed decisions and missed symptoms.
* **Triage nurses are expensive and inefficient**, yet essential for collecting high-quality data.

Paratus solves these problems, ensuring patients feel heard before their visit and doctors can focus on diagnosis, not data collection.

### **What Patients Are Saying**

_"I called as a mother for my son’s ear pain. I was impressed by the AI’s clarity, empathy, and ability to ask the right questions. Honestly, it was better to talk to than a real nurse!"_

### **Why Us?**

Best friends Tannen Hall and Pablo Bermudez-Canete, both AI students from Stanford, founded Paratus Health to fix a problem they experienced firsthand—the broken patient intake process.

For 11 years, Tannen watched his family members - and himself - grow sicker without a diagnosis for a rare disease. They endured months-long waits for every appointment, only to leave with more questions than answers. Each new doctor started from scratch, missing critical details that could have led to the right diagnosis sooner. By the time they finally got answers, it was too late to undo the damage.

That experience left Tannen frustrated with a system that forces patients to wait in limbo while their health deteriorates. He wrote about this problem in his Stanford application, and today, there is no one more determined to fix it.

Now, he and Pablo are building Paratus, an AI-powered intake platform that ensures no patient is left waiting without support and no doctor walks in unprepared.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87836&key=user_uploads/1786718/3a9b560c-8f62-4376-9297-67a19ff14f04)

### **Our Vision**

A world where doctors walk in ready to diagnose, not gather symptoms- because every patient’s full story is already in their hands.

### **Our Ask**

We’re currently running pilots and looking to connect with:

* Hospitals
* Physician offices
* Outpatient facilities
* Private clinics

Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/pablo-paratushealth/30min?month=2025-02)!

If you know someone who should see this, we’d love an introduction! Reach us at [pablo@paratushealth.com](https://mailto:pablo@paratushealth.com) or on [linkedin!](https://www.linkedin.com/company/paratushealth/)

launches.body:
Hey everyone, we're Mathieu, Thomas and Nicolas, two brothers and a best friend building COACH.

**TL;DR:** We're building the best coach for in-person sales ever built: reps record every in-person meeting from our app, and our AI turns it into precise, personalized coaching. And it works so well that 5 months in, thousands of reps already run on COACH, and we're live with the top 5 in-person sales companies in France, lifting conversion rates by 32% on average.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yJB7wC3ddTM>

## The Problem

85% of sales in the world happen face-to-face. And in-person selling is brutally hard: a rep alone in someone's living room, reading signals, handling doubts, feeling the exact moment to push.

The best reps catch what no playbook can teach. That's why 20% of them bring in 80% of the revenue, and nobody knows what they're doing differently. The only way to find out is to physically be there: a ride-along, a full day, 100 km of driving to watch a single meeting. It doesn't scale.

## The Solution

COACH's AI learns how to close customers for your business, and closes the gap at every layer of the sales org:

* **Every rep gets a personal coach:** they record every in-person meeting from our mobile app, in-home, showroom, door-to-door, and walk out of each one with personal, precise feedback and a clear path to the next close. Our AI learns from your top 20% and coaches everyone to perform like them, starting each day with a morning brief on their weakest point. 90% improve on it in their first week.
* **The company gets a sales brain that learns how to close its customers:** every meeting feeds it. Why is one region closing twice as much as another? Which objection is killing deals this month? Leadership just asks, COACH has the answer.

Thousands of reps already run on COACH, live with the top 5 in-person sales companies in France, where we've lifted conversion rates by 32% on average, and dozens of reps 3–4×'d their numbers. We're now growing fast in the USA, where our first customers are switching from virtual ride-along platforms to COACH.

Every rep gets a coach. Your company gets a brain.

## The Team

At 18 and 21, we built Alsace Test: a 44-rep field sales team that did €3.5M in 14 months. Alsace made us fall in love with in-person sales, obsessed, actually.

And one thing was driving us crazy: same product, same material, same training, and one guy closed 4× more than the others. We were driving 2,000 km a week just to watch reps sell.

So we asked them to record themselves. Suddenly, without moving, we were listening to 10 hours of meetings a day. That was COACH before COACH.

In an AI-driven sales world, we're deeply convinced Zoom sales and call centers will soon be replaced by AI agents. Face-to-face selling will be the last human job on Earth. We're betting on it.

## Our Ask

If you run 5+ field sales reps, let's talk, we'll show you how to make them superhuman.
